name: How do you maintain kitchen storage when removing walls in an open-concept remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do you maintain kitchen storage when removing walls in an open-concept remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: When walls are taken down, upper wall cabinets are eliminated, requiring smart layout adjustments to preserve storage. A well-planned kitchen island often serves as the centerpiece of an open remodel, incorporating deep storage drawers, pull-out organizers, and under-counter appliances like microwaves or wine coolers. Many homeowners also opt for tall pantry cabinets along remaining perimeter walls or integrate ceiling-height cabinetry. Using the island for both food prep and casual seating helps replace the function of separated dining and cooking zones.
acceptedAnswer.description: Incorporate a large multi-functional island with deep drawers, install ceiling-height perimeter cabinets, and add dedicated pantry units on remaining solid walls.
